depth.formula: (hip_y - knee_y) / femur_length; positive = hip below knee (deep)

torso_lean.formula: angle between hip->shoulder vector and vertical, degrees
torso_lean.rule: flag as heuristic tip if aggregated_value > threshold
torso_lean.note: 95th percentile of clean-clip reference distribution; not calibrated against direct ground truth

heel_lift.formula: (heel_y_baseline - heel_y) / shin_length; baseline = mean heel_y of first 5 detected frames
heel_lift.note: cross-check against knee-error clips showed reversed direction from assumed 'bad form' interpretation; likely reflects intentional heel-elevation technique, not a fault

known_limitations.knees_inward: explored, AUC~0.53 (near chance), not shipped — consistent with published literature showing this is a hard problem even for sophisticated models
known_limitations.knees_forward: explored via 3 feature variants (lateral offset, shin angle, knee-vs-toe), all AUC~0.5, not shipped — likely a 3/4-angle camera-geometry limitation, not a code issue
known_limitations.multi_person_clips: ~23% of training clips had a spotter present; deployment assumes single-person frame, not handled
